Santana is an American Latin rock band formed in San Francisco , California in 1966 by Mexican-American guitarist Carlos Santana . The band first came to widespread public attention when their performance of `` Soul Sacrifice '' at Woodstock in 1969 provided a contrast to other acts on the bill . This exposure helped propel their first album , also named Santana , into a hit , followed in the next two years by the successful Abraxas and Santana III . In the years that followed , lineup changes were common . Carlos Santana 's increasing involvement with guru Sri Chinmoy took the band into more esoteric music , though never quite losing its initial Latin influence . In 1998 , Santana was inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame , with Carlos Santana , Jose `` Chepito '' Areas , David Brown , Gregg Rolie , Mike Carabello and Michael Shrieve being honored . The band has earned nine Grammy Awards and three Latin Grammy Awards , the latter all in 2000 .
